title: Introduce staged sample digest and one-line changelog preview generator
author: Lena Park
description: Motivation: onboarding churn and noisy changelogs make releases hard to skim. This PR introduces a staged sampling digest and a one-line changelog preview generator to produce concise release notes from sampled model onboarding artifacts and lightweight performance deltas. The feature produces: 1) staged_sample_digest: deterministic, reproducible sample of N examples (configurable) from the onboarding corpus with provenance hashes; 2) preview_changelog: heuristics to condense profile deltas into 1–3 bullet lines, including latency/p95, token-cost delta and regression flags; 3) CLI: `redwood-model-registry onboard preview --profile <id>` to generate preview JSON/markdown; 4) web UI preview hook: small server route that renders sample snippets and preview blurbs for reviewer sign-off. Implementation: adds a Python sampler module, a Go-based changelog summarizer with a thin wrapper, a canonical manifest schema bump (manifest_v1 -> manifest_v1.1), deterministic RNG seed handling for reproducibility, and unit+integration tests. Backwards compatibility: manifest v1 files are still accepted; preview feature is opt-in via a feature flag. Testing and rollout: feature gated behind `onboarding.preview.enabled`; rollout will be canaried and monitored by new telemetry metrics `model_registry.preview.generated` and `onboarding.sampled.count`. Checklist: - [x] sampler implementation - [x] changelog heuristics - [x] CLI and server route - [x] tests and fixtures - [x] docs quickstart - [x] telemetry and dashboards. Related work: builds on prior sampling and changelog efforts (see ENG-4321). Linear/Jira references: ENG-5432 for design, PM-87 for product acceptance, SUP-341 for support request. Merge: squash-and-merge. This PR aims to reduce reviewer cognitive load and accelerate release note drafting; summarizer rules are intentionally transparent and rule-based (no opaque ML blackbox).

Lena Park: Heuristic updated: deltas <1% are summarized only if accompanied by a qualitative regression flag (accuracy/regression_detected).

release_notes: Introduce `onboard preview` feature: generates a reproducible staged sample digest and a concise one-line changelog preview for model onboarding. Configurable sample size, stratified sampling, and manifest v1.1 support. Opt-in via `onboarding.preview.enabled`. Adds telemetry metrics for preview generation and a small web preview route for reviewer signoff.
